Please kindly note that the battery life is influenced by three main factors: battery capacity, ambient temperature, and power consumption.

Battery Capacity
Venustas offers three types of batteries, with the largest being the Venustas-10000. This is the highest capacity battery on the market, rated at 7.4V@10,000mAh(=3.7V@20,000mAh), comparable to 5V@20,000mAh batteries available today. Under constant ambient temperature and power consumption, a larger battery capacity means longer usage time.

Ambient Temperature
At room temperature, the battery can discharge 100% of its capacity. However, at -10°C (14°F), the battery discharges only about 70% of its capacity, and at -20°C (-4°F), it discharges around 50% of its capacity. Thus, using the same battery with the same product in different temperatures can lead to a difference in usage time of up to 1 to 1.5 times.

Power Consumption
Under constant ambient temperature and battery capacity, larger heating elements in heated garment consume more power, which leads to quicker battery drain and shorter usage time. This means that a garment with 6 heating elements will have a battery life about 0.5 to 1 times shorter than one with 3 heating elements.

As part of our efforts to reach our environmental goals,Venustas no longer includes a power adapter in the box.

Plug Into Power To charge your device, follow these steps:
1. Connect your device to the USB cable that comes with it.
2. Plug into one of these three power sources:

Wall power outlet
Plug your USB charging cable into a USB power adapter, then plug the adapter into the wall.

Computer
Plug your charging cable into a USB 2.0 or 3.0 port on a computer that's on and not in sleep mode.

Power accessory
Plug your cable into a powered USB hub, docking station, or other Apple-certified accessory.

*As part of our efforts to reach our environmental goals, Venustas no longer includes a power adapter in the box.
  *Venustas rechargeable batteries are compatible with all kinds of Power Adapter or third-party adapters that comply with applicable safety standards.
